## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm run lint`, `pnpm run typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] `pnpm run build && pnpm run docs:gen` leaves `docs/reference/tools.md` and `docs/data/schema.md` unchanged, or the regenerated files are included
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has an entry under `[Unreleased]` for user-visible changes
- [ ] New or changed settings are in `.env.example` and `docs/configuration.md`
